T-Rex: Insta-kills any unit it attacks. No way to survive the hit.
Carnibulb: Has an insta-kill melee attack. Also has Trample.
Mega Mutant: Lacerate insta-downs any cat it hits. Gains 99 Brace when attacked, making burst damage useless.
Gatekeeper: Melee attack insta-downs its target and permanently reduces CON by 2.
Daddy Shark: Insta-kills one adjacent target by eating it. Prioritizes units with Bleed.
Caveman Chief: Insta-kills enemies with 10 or fewer HP. Gives All Stats Up to all humanoid allies.
Brute: Instantly downs any unit below 50% HP with an uppercut.
Megasaucer: Explodes on death. Has a two-tile-wide insta-kill laser.
Saucie: Gets 3 turns per round (4 as champion). Fires infinite-range projectiles in X pattern.
Hot Poker: Gets 2 turns per round with 2 move+attack sequences each. Three different melee attacks.
Cultist Mutant: Two turns per round with a three-tile-wide melee attack that lobs units.
Half-Dog: Takes 2 turns per round. Leap attack triggers reactively when damaged.
Scorpion Cat: Two turns per round. Grapples targets with Immobile and Poisons with sting.
Hyde: Attacks 3-4 times per turn with high speed. Jekyll transforms into this after 3 turns.
Bat: Multi-hit melee attack (1 damage x4 hits). High luck makes it dodge frequently.
Raptor: Fury Swipes with 75% chance to repeat each hit. Packs coordinate to attack together.
Waggle: Transforms units it can one-shot into allied Waggles instead of killing them.
Twister: Inanimate and immune to all damage and status effects. Tosses units 3-5 tiles for 5 damage. Moves first every round.
Atomic Kitten: Explodes in range 2 at start of turn, teleports when hit, and explodes again on death.
Boomer: Explodes on death dealing 5 damage to all adjacent and diagonal tiles.
Gasper: Spews poison gas on surrounding tiles. Explodes into more poison gas on death.
Cancer Cat: Melee attack has 30% chance to inflict Cancer disorder. Explodes after 3 turns.
Seraphim: Revives dead allies. Has infinite-range diagonal attack.
Skeleton Cat: Revives itself after being downed unless the corpse is destroyed.
Skeleton Kitten: Gains 6 Shield and status immunity when downed. Revives after 1 turn.
Maelestes: Steals equipment from cats. The stolen equipment is permanently lost.
Throbbing Servant: 15% chance per hit to destroy equipment and replace it with a parasite.
Host (Enemy): Reflects all projectiles back at the attacker. Knocks back melee attackers at front.
Tall Tumor: Drains mana from all cats when they end their turn, dealing damage equal to mana drained.
Tiny Tumor: Permanently reduces CON by 1. 30% chance to inflict Cancer disorder.
Fernsehbot: Issues orders that disable cat actions (no move / no attack / no abilities). Issues Doom when alone.
Fleshy Mind: Lobbed attack inflicts Muted on ALL enemies in range. Muted persists until the Fleshy Mind is downed.
Peashy: Blocks damage from the front. Becomes enraged after killing a unit, gaining Bleed 3 on attacks.
The Collective: All cats counterattack simultaneously when any member is hit.
Der Fötus: When killed at low health, primes an airstrike that damages everything in the marked area.
